steps.name: An Ominous Sign
steps.objective: Obtain one <Ancient Relic Fragment> from a [Suspicious Imperial Ranger Knight] in the "Ell Anor Southern Plains", then report to "Jade".

steps.name: Unrest in El Anoir
steps.objective: 1. Talk to [Jade] in the "Infinite Corridor", then ask the [Guild Union Guard] in the "Guild Union" about the commotion.\n2. Talk to the [Guild Union Guard] in the "Void Sea", then find [Lena Hyren] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You obtained this from the imperial soldiers...?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Magical archaeology is not my specialty... but this style appears to date from the [Second Age].

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The Second Age... Before the ancient gods and the servants of the demon realm began their great conflict. They say it was a peaceful yet strangely faded era, an uneasy time when darkness slowly gnawed at people's weaknesses and led them into corruption.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...The relic itself is nothing remarkable. But it bears traces of having been buried with a being of extraordinary magical power.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: That must be what the imperial army took. What exactly have they carried away?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: ...I have a bad feeling about this.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You there, inform the residents of the contents of this proclamation.

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: Yes, sir! Understood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...? A proclamation?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Ah, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Mr. Einst. What's happening?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Ah... There has been an incident near the El Anor mountains. We're warning residents to be careful if they pass through the area for the time being.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Hmm. I doubt it would pose much trouble for you... Still, be cautious if you have reason to go there.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You can reach the outer edge of the mountains surrounding El Anor Plains through the Void Sea.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Our union's soldiers are keeping watch. Follow their directions, and take care not to venture too far in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: This road leads to the El Anor mountains. An imperial airship has crashed there, and the area is currently in considerable turmoil.

lines.speaker: 길드연합 가드
lines.text: I won't prevent you from passing, but it is extremely dangerous. I would still advise you to turn back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I should head back and see how things develop. Perhaps I'll try the tavern...)

steps.name: A Request from the Empire and the Guild Union
steps.objective: Defeat the [Imperial Knight Captain] in the "Knight Captain's Room" at the "Airship Crash Site", then report to [Lena Hyren] in the "Guild Inn".

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: And here is the very person we were discussing.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Indeed... %s, come over here a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, hello, Miss Lena, Mr. Einst. What's going on?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Hello. I have a job for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A job?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Yes. I was supposed to handle it myself, but something has come up.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: You may consider this an official request from the empire.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: And we are cooperating fully with the empire on this matter. Consider it a request from the Guild Union as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... What exactly is the job?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: You're familiar with our empire's [Ranger Knights], who have been causing trouble around here lately.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Our investigation identified them as a reconnaissance unit that lost contact with the homeland some time ago.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Whether they have betrayed the empire, whether there are other circumstances, what their objective is... Discovering that is one of my missions.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Until now, I had no opportunity to investigate. But a chance has presented itself.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: The unit's flagship has crashed at the foot of the mountains surrounding El Anor Plains.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: We don't yet know why. ...I can't help wondering whether it was the price of flying freely over Guild Union territory, but that's only speculation.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: ...If you think the Guild Union attacked an imperial ship, all I can say is that you are mistaken.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Hmm. I consider the Guild Union's ability to make flexible decisions as circumstances demand one of its strengths... Of course, I wasn't making an accusation. I hope you won't take offense, Lord Einst.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Not at all. Haha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This feels like listening to a fox and a raccoon dog trying to outwit each other...)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: In any case, it's an excellent opportunity. Go to the airship crash site, find the commander of the [Blue Orca], and take him alive. And be sure to report anything you discover.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: ...The relic... Is it ready...?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Yes, sir. Preparations are complete. It's here...

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: ...Good. You must... carry out the mission...

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Yes, sir. I will now begin transporting the excavated object.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: ...After an age of endurance... open the gates of ruin... Let everything... burn in the master's wrath...

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: (The captain... feels a little strange.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a knight over there who looks important. Is he the imperial commander?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I can sense... an evil presence!

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: !! Damn, the enemy has come this far... I'll buy you time. Get to safety.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: ...Pay them no mind...

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: ...Find an opening and escape... Carry out your mission...

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Y-yes, sir.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: ...Insignificant vermin...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here he comes! Everyone, be careful!

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Gaaah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. I think it's over. That soldier from earlier... got away. Damn...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...He was carrying something too, some object with ominous magic.

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, he's coming around. Hmm. Should we tie him up so he doesn't attack again...?

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Ugh, what in the world...? Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He's changed. That evil presence is gone.)

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Hmm! Intruders! Do you know this is the [Blue Orca], blessed by Her Majesty the Queen of the Silvarian Empire?!

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: Cease your futile resistance! Otherwise...

lines.speaker: 기사대장
lines.text: I, Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third, swear on my honor as a knight to punish you without mercy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...What a long name...)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Stop. Wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Miss Lena. Mr. Einst.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: It has been some time, Sir Bjor.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: The young lady of House Hyren! What brings you to such a place?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Sir Bjor, these are my friends and allies of the empire. They are not our enemies.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: And I am here to carry out Her Majesty's will... To find you.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: What? To find... me?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Indeed. Her Majesty wishes to know why you violated military law and turned your back on the imperial banner. And what result you hoped to achieve.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: What?! W-what are you saying?!

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: I, Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third, have never for an instant forgotten my duty as an imperial knight!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Now that I pay attention, there's an unbelievable word hidden in that name...)

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: W-why would Her Majesty suspect me of such a thing...? I cannot understand it.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Lady Hyren... He is sincere.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: ...I see. If the [Beholder] says so, it must be true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Beholder?)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Now, Sir Bjor. Then let me ask you this.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Why did you cut off contact with the homeland? What were you doing while you were hidden from us? Why did you enter El Anor Plains, in Guild Union territory? What relic did you excavate here?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: I-I don't understand what you're saying. I was carrying out my regular duties, leading my unit along our usual patrol route...

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: ...Leading...?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Yes... And then we entered... an enormous [Gate] that appeared without warning...

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: A Gate...?

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: ...On that beautiful plain... covered in flowers... I met someone...

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: There... he said... U-urgh... My head...

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Enough. Do not try to remember any more.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Lord Einst, we still need to hear the rest.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The remnants of a powerful, malevolent magic still bind him. Pressing him now would be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: ...Hmm.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Let us return to town and seek help from the mages and paladins. His recovery, in body and mind, must come first.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Understood. At least we now know that Sir Bjor and his unit are not traitors.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: We are relieved as well. I'd rather not cross swords in earnest with the empire. Haha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes!

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: You've been a great help. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Haha, you're welcome. I'm glad I could help.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: It seems you and your friends really are the ones the queen foresaw...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What did you just say...?

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Oh, nothing. Thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (“Foresaw”... She must mean that power the imperial queen possesses... Is there something in their fate worthy of the queen's attention?)

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: You have a right to know what's happening. Once we understand more, I'll be sure to tell you.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: I have a feeling we'll be seeing a lot of each other.

lines.speaker: 레나 하이렌
lines.text: Then... see you later.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Safe travels.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. I'll see you again, then.

lines.speaker: 비요르경
lines.text: Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third... faces his greatest crisis...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Hmm. If the knight captain who fought me wasn't in his right mind, someone must have made him that way. Who could it be? What do they want?)

steps.name: One More Request
steps.objective: 1. Accept the request from [Lena Hyren] in the "Guild Inn", then go to the "Belfa Library" in the "Void Sea".\n2. Talk to [Pel] and [Liz], then defeat [Ifrit] in the "Magic Book Reading Room". Return and report to [Pel].

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh, you... I caused you a great deal of trouble the other day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, hello, Miss Lena, Mr. Einst, Sir Bjor.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Jade, you're here too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Bjor, are you feeling better now?

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh, yes! I, Bjo~r, am the very picture of physical health.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: My head, however, seems to be having some trouble... (Dejected)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Now, Sir Bjor, there is no need to blame yourself.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty will not reproach you either.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Ah... To receive Her Majesty's consideration only makes me feel more apologetic and ashamed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Speaking of which, have you found out what happened?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I can't say we've uncovered anything definite.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We do, however, have a plan for what to do next.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... I have a feeling I'm part of that plan.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Perceptive... Hehe. Well? Would you be willing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choose an answer.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: A sincere answer. A good one.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: All right. Then let's go straight into the briefing.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We'll review what we know so far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Choose someone to speak with.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It all began with a Gate that Sir Bjor's patrol fleet discovered by chance in the Void Sea.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It wasn't listed on any navigational chart. Sir Bjor decided to conduct a reconnaissance in force.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Beyond the Gate was a beautiful plain, filled with flowers as far as the eye could see.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: It was beautiful, but something about it felt strange.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: That is the last clear memory Sir Bjor or the other imperial soldiers have.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Their accounts of what followed are confused and fragmentary.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We must discover who dared dishonor the imperial banner and toy with our soldiers, who are subjects of the empire.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Indeed! Such vile deeds must be the work of an evil mage with wicked designs on the world! I shall not forgive it!

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (An evil mage...)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (I hope that's all it is...)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: While lifting the magic that had ensnared the imperial soldiers, I investigated the spell itself.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: The form of its formulas... They were exceedingly ancient and ominous, almost religious in nature.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I could not determine precisely whose magic it was.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: But one thing is certain: the caster seized the minds of most of the imperial soldiers in an instant.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Magic that takes hold of so many minds at once... Such a feat would be difficult even for the greatest archmage.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I suspect a powerful being beyond the realm of humanity is behind this.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: We won't know who is responsible until we confront them, but I do have my suspicions.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Even after the Demon King's defeat, turmoil continued. There was a time when it seemed Freios itself might be destroyed.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: That chaos lasted until the first empire arose.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Much of it was brought about by humans themselves. But not all.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: For example... The primordial gods of darkness, distinct from the ancient gods we worshiped.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There is the [Demon Realm] they created.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The Demon Realm is... No, that is too long a story. We shall discuss it another time.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: In any case, those primordial evils were largely driven from this world as the ancient empire established itself.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The cause of this incident... Might it be connected to those dark and ancient memories? That is the feeling I have.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Good. Then let me give you the assignment.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'd like you to go to Belpa Library.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belpa?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's a library. And also a temple.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? A library and a temple...?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You'll understand when you see it.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What matters is that among its magical relics is an object believed to be the counterpart of the one the imperial army excavated in El Anor Plains.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: There is a strong chance that the relic in Belpa has already been stolen as well.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: ...I vaguely remember giving that order while I was not myself. The soldier who received it is exceptionally capable and would surely have carried it out... Unfortunately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... That's not good.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Whether or not the relic has been stolen, we should be able to learn more at Belpa. It's the best place to start.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Head to Belpa first. Examine whatever evidence remains and do what you think is necessary.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I've told them an adventurer commissioned by the Guild Union is coming. The librarian at Belpa will help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll be on my way.

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh, thank you! We're counting on you!

choices.text: 2. As long as the pay is good.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hehe. You have more business sense than I expected. If things go well, the imperial court will reward you.

choices.text: 3. Let's teach whoever toyed with Sir Bjor a lesson!

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: Oh! You would go that far for me, though we've only just met...?

lines.speaker: 기사대장 비요르
lines.text: I, Maximilian Hadonpar Blamidius Haronak Dondekman Darthvaders Bjo~r the Third, am deeply moved!!!!

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's been a while since we heard the full name. You've cheered Sir Bjor right up. Haha.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hm? “Go-go-go”...? What does that mean? In any case, you seem impatient to move things along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, hello. Are you the librarian here?

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: (Nods) Are you from the Guild Union?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It's a pleasure to—

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: (Tugs) This way, please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: H-huh...? (The librarian grabs your arm and pulls you along. What an impatient person.)

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: Pel, the person we've been waiting for has arrived.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: ...Hehe.

lines.speaker: 사서
lines.text: No escaping into fantasy. (Snatches)

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Squawk! My precious! My book! My book is flying through the air?!

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, Liz... I'm sorry. I lost myself for a moment. Mrs. Blanket's [Garter Belt Assassination] was charging down the third-base line and dealing a fatal blow to the enemy's table manners. It was such a gripping scene...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: ...Even if it is trashy literature, this book belongs to the library, not you. And losing yourself? At a time like this? Pel, you are forbidden to read until this situation is resolved.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Ohhh... I suppose I have no choice. All right.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: By the way, who are they?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: The adventurers from the Guild Union we've been waiting for.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, I see! Hello! I'm so glad you're here.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: This is Pel, chief librarian of Belpa Library. Please call me Liz.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. Hello, Pel, Liz.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, I don't know whether you've heard, but...

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh, yes. You wish to see the ancient elven magical relic in our keeping.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elven...?) Yes, that's right. Is the relic safe? It hasn't been stolen, has it...?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: In fact, we would like to know that ourselves.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... Something has happened, then?

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Yes. After receiving word, our director entered the [Secret Archive] to check on the relic. She has not yet returned.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: And then monsters suddenly began rampaging through the library.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Creatures originating from books and relics have always appeared here in Belpa, particularly in the magic reading room. But nothing like this has happened before.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Moreover, a tremendous heat and magical force are raging within the [Secret Archive], where the relic you seek is kept.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Unfortunately, this is our librarians' week of community service. Most of them are away from the library.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We judged it too dangerous for our few remaining staff to approach the archive, so we have been standing by.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: The director and an elven mage who came to investigate something were both in the Secret Archive... I hope they're safe.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Well, the director is no pushover, but she is getting on in years.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. Then we'd better hurry. The Secret Archive, you said? Where's the entrance?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Go into the [Magic Reading Room] this way and continue to the very back. You'll find the entrance there.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: It may be called the Secret Archive, but the entrance isn't hidden. You should find it easily.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Please, be careful!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: More intruders...!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A fire spirit—and an incredibly powerful one!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...This feeling... Is it out of control? It seems blinded by rage... Oh no, the library could go up in flames at any moment!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: You vile thieves! You won't escape me!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Taste the wrath of Ifrit!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Hah... You're quite capable...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems to have calmed down a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, wait! We're not thieves! The Belpa librarians sent us!

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: ...You do not appear to be lying...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whew, thank goodness. I was worried about what would happen if we kept fighting.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Listen. We heard the director of Belpa Library came here before us. Where is she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...D-don't tell me... She was burned to a crisp...?

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: She was not. She leads the priestesses and possesses great power.

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: She left in pursuit of the thief. I do not know where she went...

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: ...The thief who stole the Book of Shadows I was guarding.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see... So you're a guardian of the relic?

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Yes. Though, to my shame, I failed to uphold my contract...

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Ugh. Forcing myself out again to speak has made the seal ache. The chill goes right through my bones...! I must return to my seal now.

lines.speaker: 이프리트
lines.text: Farewell, mighty human warriors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Chilled to the bone? Is being sealed something like having rheumatism?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I'd better tell the people waiting in the lobby what we learned.

steps.name: To the Forgotten Plains
steps.objective: 1. Finish talking to [Pel] and [Liz] in the "Belfa Library", then take the portal in "Void Sea 4" to the "Forgotten Plains".\n2. Talk to the "Elite Ranger" in the "Forgotten Plains", then turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Oh... A thief in the Secret Archive.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: I see... Losing the relic is serious, but I'm relieved the director is safe.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Still, assigning Ifrit, a high-ranking fire spirit, to guard a book... What a thoroughly chaotic idea. Huh...

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: We Belpa librarians guard knowledge, and [books] in particular. That is precisely why we know a thing or two about handling fire, Pel.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: Well, that's true.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: I admit it is an unusual idea, though. It seems there's another librarian to rival even you, Pel.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: What? Hehehe, I'm not that special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I don't think that was a compliment.)

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: In any case, I believe we owe you an apology.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? An apology? Is the stolen relic the one we're looking for?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: As you suspect, the book Ifrit guarded is the relic you seek: the [Book of Shadows].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Book of Shadows... That sounds like a spellbook.

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: Correct. According to the relevant texts, the Book of Shadows has the power to banish something from [reality] into the world of [shadows].

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: It is also described as a [fragment of destruction created to prevent the world's destruction]. Fighting poison with poison, perhaps?

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: If someone with ill intentions has taken the book... it could bring a great catastrophe.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: ...I-it was something that frightening...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... This keeps getting more serious, and heavier. I really don't like it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, there seems little reason to stay in Belpa. I need to go after whoever stole the relic.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: What do you intend to do next?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I'm going to try the unidentified Gate the imperial army found in the Void Sea.

lines.speaker: 펠
lines.text: An unidentified Gate! Who knows what dangers await beyond it? How exciting...! May luck be with you!

lines.speaker: 리즈
lines.text: May Leda bless your path.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: More... enemies? I may not... be able to take any more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. We're not your enemies.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: You are... the ones I met on the airship.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. You were the soldier beside Sir Bjor, weren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't need to be so wary. There was a reason we fought Sir Bjor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone named Lena Hyren gave me this insignia. She said you'd trust me if I showed it to you... Do you?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Hyren... One of the empire's greatest noble houses... Oh, this is...!

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: This is the emblem of the [Silver Claw], the imperial court's special organization.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: ...It is an imperial soldier's duty to cooperate with whoever bears this emblem. Understood. Tell me what you need.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. I'm glad we could clear that up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, you were the one who entered Belpa Library and took the relic, weren't you?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: ...Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Bjor's orders weren't his own. Apparently, an unknown magic was controlling him and many of the imperial soldiers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The relic excavated in El Anor Plains and the one taken from the library both need to be returned. Please give them to me.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: The captain was... being controlled by magic?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: ...I see... Yes... That does make sense.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: The way my comrades were acting... Looking back, there were so many suspicious things. I was a fool...

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: I'm sorry. I no longer have the relics.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Then...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I look, you're badly hurt...! Does that mean...?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: It is probably as you imagine. Following my orders, I entered the [Flower Garden], where the recipient should have been waiting for the relics.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Flower Garden... Is that its entrance over there?)

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: But the person I was to meet was nowhere to be seen. Instead, countless monsters appeared...

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: I barely escaped, but lost the relics on the way out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Then the relics should still be in that garden.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: There is a chance they aren't, but it needs to be checked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know who requested the relics?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: My only orders were to bring them here. I know nothing beyond that.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: You seem to be adventurers of extraordinary ability.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Please. Would you recover the relics from that garden?

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: If they fall into the hands of the empire's enemies and are misused, the consequences could be terrible...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was planning to do that even without being asked. Stay here and recover your strength.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Thank you. I'm ashamed to trouble you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, all you did wrong was faithfully follow orders. Don't blame yourself too much.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: ...Thank you.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Then I wish you victory.

steps.name: A Suspicious Garden (1)
steps.objective: Defeat "Cerberus", the monster [Degos] mentioned, in the "Forgotten Garden", then report to the missing mage [Soleil] to turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 청년 귀족
lines.text: Well, unfamiliar faces. A pleasure to meet you.

lines.speaker: 청년 귀족
lines.text: Adventurers, are you...? Wandering wherever your feet take you in such a fine season... How lovely. It makes me wish I could set off somewhere too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, hello. Um, you are...?

lines.speaker: 청년 귀족
lines.text: Ah, I've forgotten to introduce myself.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: My name is Degos. I am the master of this place. A pleasure.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: I'm embarrassed to say it myself, but isn't it a beautiful garden? It's my pride and joy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's wonderful. Splendid, yet somehow unassuming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The plain outside looks so peaceful and happy too... This whole area is beautiful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Though I can't seem to sense anyone around... Perhaps because it's such a quiet countryside.)

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Thank you. My subjects are kind and hardworking, so this is a pleasant land to live in.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: As an incompetent lord, I can only feel grateful and apologetic toward them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... You're the lord of this land.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Perfect. I can ask him about this place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me, but there's something I'd like to ask...

lines.speaker: 짐승의 울부짖음
lines.text: Grooooooooooar—

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Hmm. That monster means to rampage again... I have no way to stop it now. This is serious...!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Oh dear, in my distraction I forgot to warn you. My apologies.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: This garden is extremely dangerous at present. Monsters are appearing everywhere.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Monsters? (The ones that ranger told me about?)

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Yes. While my men and I were hunting on the plain near the garden, an enormous beast suddenly appeared.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: We managed to drive it into this garden, but then many smaller monsters appeared, seemingly its servants...

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: We barely drove them back, and my men were badly hurt. I've sent them to call for reinforcements.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Frankly, it feels like more than I can handle... But it would be a disaster if the creature escaped the garden and attacked my subjects, wouldn't it? As their lord, I must do something. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: You're welcome to visit once peace returns to the garden. For now, you should take shelter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the situation, I'd like to help.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Hmm? You would help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Please leave the monsters to me.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: ...Wonderful! I'm deeply moved!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: To risk danger for others... Such incomparable nobility of spirit...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-nobility? It's nothing that grand.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: No need for modesty. Not everyone would put themselves in danger for someone else, as you would.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Truthfully, my men and I should be the ones to solve this. But neither they nor I are particularly accustomed to fighting.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: It's been so long since this land last saw conflict... I'm not even sure we can fight properly anymore. How embarrassing.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: In fact, I could tell at first glance that you were powerful adventurers. I'm sure you could handle it.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: I am ashamed as a lord... But I must put my pride aside and ask for your help.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Please clear the monsters from the garden, then defeat the three-headed monstrous dog that appears to lead them.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: It is for my subjects' safety. If you resolve this, I will show my gratitude as generously as I can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll do my best.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Good. I look forward to hearing good news. May victory be yours!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Wait here, then. Stay safe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, shall we go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...But I've felt for a while as though I'm forgetting something... What is it?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't know. Perhaps it's the lovely weather... My thoughts seem sluggish...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And this floral scent... Isn't the garden's fragrance... a little... too strong?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Hmm. Am I overheated? I need to pull myself together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come on, let's go!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text:
...
Hehehe...

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Groooooooooooooar—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that's the cry I heard at the entrance...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're the culprit!

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Grrrrrrrrrrrrr!!!!!!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, but I'll have to make you behave!

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Whiiiine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. That was a hard fight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a shame, but I can't let you keep rampaging...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry...!

lines.speaker: 케르베로스
lines.text: Whine... Whiiiine...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Wait a moment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: No! Don't hurt that puppy!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: M-Miss Platina?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...A puppy...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this Cerberus... your pet, by any chance...?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...That was awful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oof.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: All right, I'll free you now...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A gentle light spreads from Platina...!)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Whew. I think it worked...!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Ahhh... Mmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Cerberus has turned into a woman! Those long ears... An elf, like the ones in Midgard?)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Oh dear, she isn't coming around. The shock must have been severe. What should I do...?

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: M-mmm... No...

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Dessert... I can't eat any more. Nom, nom...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hiyah!

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: Oh... Oh my?

lines.speaker: 엘프 여성
lines.text: P-Platina?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...Whew. You're finally awake, Soleil.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh, um... Good morning?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It is not!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I-I dreamed I was a winged dog. I ran and played among beautiful flowers, with the breeze rushing past me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wasn't she dreaming about dessert? ...Was I the dessert?!...)

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Honestly... That's just like you, Soleil.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Soleil...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Miss Platina, if she's Soleil, could she be...?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Hm? You know Soleil?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The elven mage Soleil who went missing from Belpa Library...?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: What...? Missing? Oh my... How terrible.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: We're talking about you, my dear. Do wake up already!

steps.name: A Suspicious Garden (2)
steps.objective: Uncover [Degos's] true identity in the "Forgotten Garden" and defeat him. Then report to the [Elite Ranger] in the "Forgotten Plains" to turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: ...Impossible. I... I...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Hah... We... won.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: ...Yes. Victory is yours!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: But don't be too pleased with yourselves.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Though not completely, the seal on this land has been broken... The barrier between the Demon Realm and this world is gone.

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: ...I will return. And when I do, I will make you beg—beg me to kill you instead!!!!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Hahahahahahaha... Look forward to the day we meet again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Damn you. I'll fight you anytime, so get out of here for now...!

lines.speaker: 데고스
lines.text: Ooooooooh—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did he return to the Demon Realm? Or was he sealed away? Whew. Either way... he's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now... I'd better rejoin Miss Platina and the others.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Thanks to you, we defeated the one who bewitched the imperial army and stole the magical relics.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: But the magic separating this land, which the Demon Realm had encroached upon, from the world is gone.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...Hmm... Things have become serious.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: This region has now returned to this world... to Freios.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: And with it, the Demon Realm that had invaded this land has become connected to our world.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: ...Ah, the road ahead will be difficult.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: First, we need to deal with what's in front of us.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: We have to stabilize this garden so the darkness covering it doesn't spill outside.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'll help too, Platina.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Well, then... You've worked very hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... But it feels like I haven't helped...

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: I'm truly sorry... This is all because of me...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Now, now! What are you saying? Defeating Degos prevented the worst outcome.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Exactly. If that Demon Lord had turned the whole region into a [doorway] to the Demon Realm and thrown it wide open, the result would have been horrifying.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: You defeated Degos before that happened. So we've contained it to something more like... a hole in a dam full of water.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: That's right. Don't be disappointed in yourself over every little thing beyond your reach.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: That goes for you too, Mr. Soldier. You didn't do well, but it's not as though you did anything truly wrong either.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: ...Ah. Do you think so...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. You're right. We should do what we can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This world's already a candle in the wind before the [Demon King]. It's only one more danger, right? Ugh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Keep getting in my way, and I'll blow you all away, you pests!

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, yes! That's the spirit! Ahaha. Adventurers who face even the Demon King can't let something like this frighten them!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The [Demon King]... Platina told me the situation, but to think a name I'd only heard in fairy tales is real... I suddenly feel faint...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I should tell the Guild Union and Miss Lena from the empire what happened. Will you two be all right? What about the soldier?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes. Thanks to you, it isn't so dangerous here anymore. Don't worry—go on! We'll look after him and send him back.

lines.speaker: 엘리트 유격병
lines.text: Though the [Book of Shadows] and [Staff of Destruction] were destroyed, at least they weren't fully exploited. Thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thank you so much. Please let me repay this kindness someday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... There's no need. Really... Well, I'll see you next time. Take care.

steps.name: Reporting on the Request
steps.objective: Find [Lena] in the "Guild Inn" and report that you have completed the request.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Degos, master of the sealed land... One of the great demons that terrorized Freios during the Second Age.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: A path connecting the Demon Realm to this world... This has become something tremendous.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (“A storm of despair will blacken the sky, and amid the raging wind, hope will come silently, like a feather.” ...That is what Her Majesty said.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (Is even this incident only an omen that these are the adventurers of destiny?)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I think you need to meet the queen and speak with her as soon as possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The queen... You mean the ruler of the empire?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: In fact, I came here on the queen's orders: to welcome you when you reached this land and bring you to her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? She knew I would come here?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes. You'll understand when you meet her. She's a mysterious person.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll tell you as soon as the preparations are ready. Thank you for everything you've done.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Since the moment you arrived in this town, you've accomplished one remarkable thing after another. I'm impressed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well... Anyone would have done the same in those circumstances...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: My, how modest.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: (As a mage, I've hoped for a chance to travel with adventurers as gifted as these and explore the world. Heh... Somehow, I feel that chance may come.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text:
(So composed, even after confronting an event of this magnitude...
As though they have something far more important than this to overcome.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Why is it that when I look at these adventurers... I feel some great turning point approaching in the fate of us [Storm Watchers]?)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Is it merely my imagination, or foresight as a [Watcher]...?)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Heh... I suppose time will tell...

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Mr. Einst...?

lines.speaker: %s
